🎬 Big Miracle (2012)

Big Miracle tells the inspiring true story of an extraordinary rescue mission in Alaska during 1988. When a local television reporter discovers three gray whales trapped beneath rapidly freezing Arctic ice, their desperate struggle for survival captures the attention of the entire world. Determined to save them, the reporter teams up with a passionate Greenpeace volunteer, bringing together local residents, Indigenous whale hunters, government officials, and even rival nations in an unlikely effort to help the animals escape. As freezing temperatures and dangerous conditions threaten the rescue, the group must overcome political differences and personal conflicts to accomplish something remarkable. Starring Drew Barrymore and John Krasinski, Big Miracle delivers a heartwarming story about compassion, teamwork, determination, and the incredible things people can achieve when they unite for a common cause.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Drama • Family

⭐ IMDb: 6.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 47m • PG

🎥 Director: Ken Kwapis

✍️ Writers: Jack Amiel & Michael Begler
